map.噪声叠加计算器，对多个声源分贝按能量叠加(支持增减声源)，求总噪声水平，用于环境: The noise superposition calculator sums multiple source decibels by energy (sources can be added or removed) to get the total noise level, used for environmental noise assessment.
map.厂界合成：录入各设备声级与距离衰减后的值，求总声级。: Site boundary synthesis: enter each device's sound level after distance attenuation and compute the total sound level.
map.室内声学：对多个噪声源录入级，判断是否超标准。: Room acoustics: enter levels for multiple noise sources and judge whether they exceed the standard.
map.教学演示：演示叠加的非线性特征。: Teaching demo: show the nonlinear nature of superposition.
map.：示例：源 A 75 dB、源 B 78 dB，合成≈80.2 dB（78 dB: : example: source A 75 dB and source B 78 dB give a combined level of about 80.2 dB (the 78 dB source dominates).
map.与噪声叠加同：总 L=10lg(Σ10^(Li/10))，本质都是声强能量叠加。: Same as noise superposition: total L = 10*lg(sum of 10^(Li/10)), essentially energy summation of sound intensity. Results are estimated from public standards and environmental factors for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction estimation; specific accounting follows official guidelines (e.g. GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
